coverageAssessment.claimedScope: No city-specific open parcel scope verified in this research pass. Country-level evidence is not attributed to this urban centre.
coverageAssessment.finding: Aleppo has an identified Directorate of Cadastral Affairs / Real Estate Registry. SANA reporting describes the directorate issuing real-estate statements and cadastral plans; this confirms registry and plan activity, not a public queryable GIS/vector source. Native Arabic search found no anonymous geometry+stable parcel ID endpoint. Earlier native-language audit also found no public GIS source. Follow-up traced the official online service linked by the national cadastral directorate: Anjez (ecsc.gov.sy) currently offers electronic registry statements in Damascus, Daraa, Quneitra and Latakia; Aleppo is not in its stated current coverage. The official report says cadastral statements and survey plans will be added later. The official Aleppo office reports issuing survey plans in person, but no public map viewer or vector API is linked. Direct Anjez access timed out from this network.

nextStep: Recheck Anjez when its announced governorate coverage expands to Aleppo and survey-plan functions launch; inspect the official public interface for a map or geometry service then. Do not infer GIS access from electronic registry statements or in-person plan issuance.
registryBasis: Aleppo cadastral office issues registry statements and survey plans. The identified national electronic service does not currently list Aleppo; no public geometry endpoint verified.
